info.title: Uptivra API
info.description: Single-tenant monitoring. Collections return arrays, monitors up to 1000, checks/incidents newest 100. Statistics use recorded checks in the last 24 hours. JSON bodies limited to 32 KiB; errors use {error}. No cross-origin browser API access.

servers.description: Same-origin dashboard proxy; use your deployment origin in production.

apiKey.description: up_ token, read or write. Read keys can access sensitive monitor headers. Write includes read. Cannot manage account/channels/keys.

session.description: 12-hour HttpOnly session; mutations require exact APP_ORIGIN in Origin header.

cron.description: CRON_SECRET only; call backend directly, not the 15-second Next.js proxy.
